caseName: First Unitarian Church of Los Angeles v. County of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: First Unitarian Church of Los Angeles v. County of Los Angeles and Valley Unitarian-Universalist Church, Inc. v. County of Los Angeles
attorneys: Kenneth W. Greenawalt for the American Civil Liberties Union, movant, urging reversal. Harold W. Kennedy for respondents in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Certiorari, 355

U. S. 853, 854, to the Supreme Court of California. The motion for leave to file brief of American Civil Liberties

Union, as amicus curiae, is granted.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
